intendedChanges.summary: Delay payment from fifteen to forty-five days; Claimant can counter with an initial installment due within fifteen days.
Expand the release from the disputed shipment to every pre-execution shipment; Claimant can counter by restoring the disputed-shipment limitation.
Delete the express exclusion for unrelated shipments to align the exclusion sentence with the expanded release.
Accelerate the packaging-check account from thirty days to ten days.
Reduce the payment-default cure period from ten days to three days.
Move the unchanged record-preservation clause from Section 4 to Section 8.
Replace contains with states in the integration sentence as a neutral clean-up.
Replace constitute with form in the counterparts sentence without changing its effect.
